incremental_findings.fact: Beacon policy registers TXS_FORMAT0. TXS_TYPE1 in AddTxSStatus is allocator routing and must not be confused with TXS_FORMAT1.
Beacon wrapper sets NSeq TRUE and zeroes long TXD before write_tmac_info; does not itself assign unique SN.

Long builder zeroes descriptor; DWORD3 assigns retry fields but no host-selected sn/sn_vld. Search found no direct TXD3 sequence writes in pinned C/H; alias/raw writes outside this search are not excluded.
bar_sn_ctrl=1 is documented as SW BAR control; does not prove beacon sequence override or echo.
FORMAT0 timestamp is exposed but no proven domain/wrap/epoch contract. Parser removes software status by PID before handler; safe extra validation would need to precede destructive removal.

conclusion: No proven nonrepeating host-selected beacon identity or safe timestamp correlation. Neither hardware-owned SN nor host SN echo may be assumed. Do not patch ACK/TxS reuse on field names alone.
